findings.description: render() is called outside the try block. A subscriber-specific failure there, such as a body template containing other braces that raise KeyError/IndexError/ValueError in str.format, aborts send_campaign partway. Earlier recipients have already been emailed and the report is lost, so a retry would re-send to them.
findings.suggestion: Handle render errors per subscriber, record them in the report, and continue. Validate the template before sending starts.
